components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main dictation and save action; use once per immediate action area.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action with lower emphasis than the current primary command.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background:#EDF1F5; color:#111C2E; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:10px 18px; font:700 13px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background:#E2E8EE; } .ds-button-secondary:active { background:#D8E0E7; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2F67E8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square native field for keys, URLs, model IDs, and language codes.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:#263548; font:700 12px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-field input { background:#FFFFFF; color:#111C2E; border:1px solid #BBC7D3; border-radius:0; padding:8px; font:400 13px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:#647386; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2F67E8; outline-offset:0; border-color:#2F67E8; } .ds-field input:disabled { background:#EDF1F5; color:#647386; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected destination in the fixed left navigation rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { width:184px; display:grid; gap:4px; padding:12px; background:#F8FAFB; border-right:1px solid #D8E0E7; } .ds-nav button { background:#F8FAFB; color:#647386; border:0; border-radius:0; padding:11px 10px; text-align:left; font:700 13px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav button:hover,.ds-nav .ds-nav-active { background:#E8EFFF; color:#2F67E8; } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2F67E8; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Signal Stage
components.description: Main microphone-to-model-to-cursor route and its current state.
components.css: .ds-signal-stage { background:#FFFFFF; color:#111C2E; border:2px solid #D8E0E7; border-radius:0; padding:18px 20px 22px; font:700 12px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-stage-status { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:28px; } .ds-stage-status span:first-child { color:#087456; } .ds-stage-status span:last-child { color:#647386; font-weight:400; } .ds-route { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:12px; text-align:center; } .ds-route b { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:76px; min-height:48px; background:#EDF1F5; border:2px solid #BBC7D3; border-radius:999px; } .ds-route i { height:2px; background:#2F67E8; position:relative; } .ds-route i::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:0; top:-3px; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:999px; background:#2F67E8; } .ds-signal-stage:hover { border-color:#BBC7D3; } .ds-signal-stage:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2F67E8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Signal Node Ready
components.description: Persistent bottom-right control shown whenever AgentWisper is running.
components.css: .ds-signal-node { width:248px; height:58px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:34px 84px 1fr; align-items:center; gap:12px; background:#111820; color:#F7FAFC; border:1px solid #344252; border-radius:18px; padding:0 16px 0 14px; font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 3px 0 #080D12; } .ds-signal-node:hover { background:#18222D; } .ds-signal-node:active { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow:0 2px 0 #080D12; } .ds-signal-node:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #2F67E8; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-signal-node .ds-port { width:26px; height:26px; border:2px solid #087456; border-radius:999px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 9px #111820; background:#F7FAFC; } .ds-signal-node svg { width:84px; height:32px; fill:none; stroke:#667789; stroke-width:2; } .ds-signal-node svg .ds-jade { stroke:#087456; } .ds-signal-node span:last-child { display:grid; text-align:left; } .ds-signal-node strong { font-size:12px; } .ds-signal-node small { color:#AAB7C5; font-size:11px; margin-top:2px; }

components.name: Error Action

narrative.overview:
AgentWisper feels like a precise audio routing desk reduced to its essential signal path. Mineral-gray workspace, paper-white surfaces, fine rules, and deep navy text keep the main app calm. Cobalt, jade, crimson, and amber communicate routing state; they are functional signals, not decoration.

The main window is a quiet control room. The persistent carbon Signal Node is its compact field instrument: visible at the edge of the active workspace, animated only while work is happening, and explicit about readiness, listening, processing, success, or failure. This visual system supports technical confidence without mimicking a centered dictation bar.
keyCharacteristics: Light mineral workspace with precise, square-edged surfaces.
Speech shown as a route from microphone to model to active cursor.
Cobalt interaction, jade completion, amber caution, and crimson recovery states.
Carbon Signal Node as the only dark persistent surface.
Native Windows density, direct labels, and restrained motion.

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal colors mark action or state; no screen becomes a cobalt, jade, amber, or crimson field.

rules.name: The One Dark Surface Rule
rules.body: Carbon belongs to the floating Signal Node. Main application pages remain mineral and paper.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Segoe UI explains and directs; Cascadia Mono identifies machine-facing details. Never set ordinary paragraphs in mono.

rules.name: The Route Before Record Rule
rules.body: Show microphone, selected model, and cursor as one readable path; never reduce the primary workspace to a giant microphone control.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Main surfaces stay flat at rest; use borders, spacing, and state color before elevation.

rules.name: The Rounded Instrument Rule
rules.body: Rounded forms belong to live signal controls and ports, not every container.

dos: Do keep privacy and provider routing visible in plain text.
Do use signal colors for specific states and pair them with written labels.
Do preserve the microphone-to-model-to-cursor route as the core visual metaphor.
Do keep the floating control at the active monitor edge without stealing focus.
Do use Segoe UI for human guidance and Cascadia Mono for compact machine metadata.
donts: Don't copy Wispr Flow's centered bar or its composition.
Don't turn the app into a generic dark card dashboard.
Don't use a giant microphone as the primary workspace control.
Don't add decorative charts, fake metrics, or ornamental animation.
Don't hide recording, processing, privacy, or failure state behind color alone.
